meta.description: The ORVIBO Zigbee Mini Gateway is the control hub of your smart home: it links hundreds of wireless devices, from sensors to switches, and runs them by themselves in the scenes you set up in the ORVIBO Home app.
alt.banner: The Zigbee Mini gateway on a table next to a vase of flowers: a smart control hub for hundreds of wireless devices.
alt.features: Standard Zigbee ZHA protocol, works with smart devices from major platforms, fast 10 ms response.
alt.scenes: Quickly set up your smart home scenes: open the door and the lights come on, the AC settles at a comfortable temperature and the hot water is ready. The Zigbee Mini gateway links the devices together.
alt.door: Open the door and the lights and AC welcome you home: through the gateway, the door & window sensor on the door turns on a smart switch and an IR blaster.
alt.window: Open the window in the morning and the AC turns itself off: through the gateway, the door & window sensor on the window turns it off with an IR blaster.
alt.away: Alerts while you're away: when the motion or door sensor detects something, your phone gets an alert and the camera starts recording.
alt.devices: The gateway works with many kinds of devices: smart switches for every light, sensors that keep track of the house and controllers that run it all in one tap.
alt.install: Tool-free install in three steps: plug the gateway into power and your router, install the app and add the device, then place the other devices where you need them.
alt.app: The ORVIBO Home app, free for iOS and Android, with scenes such as a light that turns on with motion.
alt.screens: ORVIBO Home app screens: the bedroom's devices, the home screen and the profile. The app brings family sharing, scenes and security.

m.scenes.title: Quickly set up your smart home scenes
m.scenes.text: Open the door and the lights come on, the AC settles at a comfortable temperature and the hot water is ready. By freely combining the ORVIBO Zigbee Mini gateway with different devices, you can easily automate every smart device in your home.
m.door.title: Open the door,
m.door.bold: the lights and AC welcome you home
m.door.text: How it works: the door & window sensor goes on the door, and on your phone you link it to a smart switch and a smart IR blaster. When the door opens, the lights and AC turn on by themselves.
m.window.title: Open the window in the morning,
m.window.text: How it works: the door & window sensor goes on the window, and on your phone you link it to a smart IR blaster. When the window opens, the AC turns off by itself.
m.away.title: Alerts while you're away,
m.away.text: How it works: on your phone, set up and turn on Away mode. If the motion sensor or the door & window sensor detects something unusual, your phone gets an alert and the linked camera starts recording.

m.devices.1: Connect smart switches to control every light
m.devices.2: Connect smart sensors to know what's going on in the whole house
m.devices.3: Connect smart controllers to run every device in one tap
m.install.title: Tool-free install,
m.install.bold: an easy start to your smart home
m.install.text: Your smart home goes in without touching your décor, in three easy steps.
m.install.1: Plug the Zigbee Mini gateway into power and your router
m.install.2: Install the app and add the device
m.install.3: Place the other devices where you need them
